title: A Summoning in Central City
pitch: Someone in Central City's inner ring summoned a Celestial on purpose. It came. It is still here, in a penthouse, ordering room service and asking questions about the Progenitors.
The headquarters chapter wants it buried before anyone learns what it is, or what it already knows.
meta: Every tension at once. The AI Narrator improvises the rest.

arc.beginning: The party reaches the penthouse; the Celestial is charming.
arc.middle: Who summoned it and why; what it knows; who else is coming for it.
arc.end: Bury it, bargain with it, or let it out.

opening: Open in the penthouse lift as it climbs the inner ring, the chapter's briefing still on the party's screens, and the doors opening on a Celestial in a bathrobe saying it has been expecting them.

zones.name: The penthouse
zones.summary: A Central City inner-ring penthouse where a summoned Celestial orders room service.

notes.text: The suite: a city view, a piano nobody plays, the Celestial.

objects.name: The Celestial
objects.text: Polite, curious, wearing a costume it will never take off, and asking about the Progenitors.

approaches.label: Find out what it knows
approaches.stakes: How much it already knows about the Progenitors.
